title: Data and code for: Separating the errors of a first-principles Néel temperature: DFT+U exchange, effective-field theory and Monte Carlo for FeF2
description: Quantum ESPRESSO inputs and outputs (calc/), exchange-constant fits, effective-field-theory results, raw Monte Carlo data and finite-size-scaling analysis (data/, mcB/, mcDC/), and the scripts that produce every table and figure (scripts/, figures/) for N. Paran, Computational Materials Science (submitted, 2026). README.md maps every table and figure to its data file and script.
